provenance: Acquired 1939 from Hans and Dr. Ulrich Rück through purchase from a private collector in Markneukirchen.
literature: Heyde 1997:101; Van der Meer 1979: 96; Van der Meer 1982: 84; Huber 1989.
remarks: Ferrules [****Zwingen, not Hülse] and both slide stays have ring pattern. Ferrule at mouthpipe and ferrule at proximal end of descending outer slide tube marked with “x,” perhaps to indicate proper positioning of outer slide. Rings in slide bow and bell bow, mounted on leaf-shaped plate. Plates for rings and ferrule at bell section entry have engraved zigzag pattern**** [Strichzeichnung]. Flat bell stay, with “4” on one side. Sleeve attaching bell stay to neck pipe is unornamented. Rather pronounced bell flare. Garland with simple drawn rim wire.
